additional_info.subject: RE: AW: 0375676 - ID0375676-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003341]Charger delivering low power CRM:02023000103
additional_info.body:
Hello Benjamin﻿,﻿
Here’s a summary of our initial analysis:
1. With
ELMS-True, without power limit
: We reviewed the logs and observed that charging was generally functioning well. However, with just one EV, we encountered issues once or twice, though it had been working fine previously.
2.With ELMS-False, with power limit
: Charging appears to be working smoothly under these conditions and delivering charging sessions was successfully started with >250kW.
Based on this initial assessment, we suspect there might be an issue with ELMS. Please note that this is not a definitive conclusion; rather, it’s part of our ongoing investigation. We will discuss our findings with experts to determine the root cause and will keep you updated on our progress.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
​​​​​​​
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: Notes to L2
additional_info.body:
As discussed with Sascha-
1. On 22nd Aug charger delivering current less than 110 amps initially and gradually it slows down to 10 amps of EVCCID":"0016810ef316","EVMAC":"00.16.81.0e.f3.16
2. RC deactivated the ELMS on 23rd Aug in between 3.30 to 4PM Germany time and limited the charger to 250kW based on customer feedback. Now a charging sessions was successfully started with >250kW. Prior to that, the same vehicle was charging at the charger with roughly 100kW.
Site intervention notes- On 27th Aug 1pm Germany time, the ELMS should be activated again, so... changes in SCB will be needed + log analysis in case we again only have slightly more than 100kW that can be charged with.

additional_info.body:
Hello,
You are right. It is not misbehavior there in the SichargeD. I guess the SichargeD work properly.
The issue here, is simple. The SichargeD (Osnabrück and Bremen) did not connected at the time and ulzil today with our PLC to receive Limits for the whole SichargeD per Modbus.
“G_Power_Min” ,  “G_Power_Max” and “G_FallbackPLim”
should be set from our last management.
I will recap the timeline of the commissioning, so you can understand what is happening.
In Osnabrück:
08 August 2024: External Load management is set in our system and read to work. In SichargeD should the EMLS option be activated. If this happens our system take control of the 3 parameters.
09 August 2024: The connection was stablished, and we took control of the parameters. If the SichargeD during this time properly worked, I can not say. You need to check your log date to find out.
09 August 2024: The SichargeD showed a “AC error” and a load action were not more possible. To solve this issue, some actions were taken in the SichargeD an since this point until today our communication to the SichargeD to control the parameters is not more present.
In Bremen
19 August 2024: External Load management is set in our system and read to work.
20 August 2024: This time some one was direct in site to configure the EMLS in SichargeD. This was not possible because the Backend could not connect to the Router. Since this day until today our communication to the SichargeD and an control of the parameters was never present.
29 August 2024: For some Reasons, the SichargeD does not give the desired power. I received an email because people thought we were responsible for this issue.
As we are not involved in this issue, a ticket was open to solve the issues in the SichargeD. I guess the power delivery issue and the EMLS issue.
Now both SichargeD work with constant Max, Min parameter
BUT without EMLS
and THIS is right now the issue.
Maybe the EMLS has no relation with the Ticket, but the whole System (SichargeD and Sistotrage NEO) are not working properly together, and the performance is not the ideal one.
I do not know If for this issue a new ticket is needed. Additionally, this not really my problem, as I am self (right now) not responsible for the SichargeD. I can only tell you, from our side is already set to control those parameters per Modbus.
If necessary, I can assist you, looking remotely if the communications works or not. We need only to coordinate the time to do this.
If you still have questions or comments, please forward those to me.
With best regards,
